content_sections.heading: DLSA Ujjain Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 170 vacancies are available – 70 for Para Legal Volunteer - Ujjain, 20 for Para Legal Volunteer - Khachrod, 20 for Para Legal Volunteer - Nagda, 20 for Para Legal Volunteer - Mahidpur, 20 for Para Legal Volunteer - Tarana, and 20 for Para Legal Volunteer - Badnagar.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Ujjain Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ujjain.dcourts.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Ujjain Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DLSA Ujjain Para Legal Volunteer posts is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Para Legal Volunteer posts is passing the 10th standard from a recognized board. No higher qualifications are mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 170 vacancies for the Para Legal Volunteer post across various locations within the Ujjain district, including Ujjain, Khachrod, Nagda, Mahidpur, Tarana, and Badnagar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for applying to the Para Legal Volunteer posts is 18 years. The maximum age limit is not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for DLSA Ujjain recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DLSA Ujjain Para Legal Volunteer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DLSA Ujjain Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the DLSA Ujjain Para Legal Volunteer posts. The application is free for all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer role involves two stages: scrutiny of applications and an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their application and then called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer position is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Legal Services Authority Ujjain, which is https://ujjain.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational certificates, along with the filled application form.
